check_model_vocabulary: check the model vocabulary size and padding index against the tokenizer in a fairseq2 RecipeContext
run_check_model_vocabulary: run check_model_vocabulary to validate that a CausalLM embedding table matches the tokenizer vocabulary
review_check_model_vocabulary: review check_model_vocabulary to understand how it validates embedding size and pad index alignment
test_check_model_vocabulary: test check_model_vocabulary with a RecipeContext containing a CausalLM and tokenizer to verify vocabulary matching
refactor_check_model_vocabulary: refactor check_model_vocabulary to add custom warning thresholds for vocabulary size mismatches
